race.comment: APOCALYPTIC (3) started hard in the market on resumption with a closing third over 1100m in the G3 Toy Show Quality at Randwick. Desperate to get out in trip and gets the economical run from the rails draw. Top three contender. LAZZURA (2) Coolmore winner resuming. Comes to hand early in the prep and wasn't knocked around in her two trials. Gets the right run and will take holding out. WEEPING WOMAN (8) resumes. Rewarded for her consistency with a dominant win in the G3 Triscay Stakes at Randwick over this trip last February. Looks to have gone to another level after the two recent trial wins. Leading player. GANGSTA GRANNY (5) can make the necessary improvement.
